g.text: Revenue is split evenly across five departments (about 20% each), and
the largest client is only 0.19% of revenue.
Monthly sales stay in a 135K to 149K band until October, then climb to
Thursday is the busiest day with 287K calls, and answer speed varies a
lot between agents, pointing at coaching or staffing opportunities.
Outlet is the largest channel (39.6% of sales), and Men's Athletic
Footwear has the lowest margin at 30.0%.
Luxor is the best-performing region and Minya the worst; Wednesday is
the peak day, and distribution edged up 0.2% on last week.
